## 2026-08-27 — agent:opencode — #003 (close)

**Done:**
- Implemented the schema-driven discovery engine (the app's core differentiator). `flutter analyze` → **0 issues**, `flutter test` → **93 passed / 1 skipped**, `discovery/` line coverage → **91.0%** (gate ≥85%).
- `lib/redfish/models/odata.dart` (ODataResource + ODataLink), `lib/redfish/models/system_features.dart` (full feature map + `copyWith`/`toJson`/`fromJson`).
- `lib/redfish/discovery/feature_rules.dart` (table-driven `FeatureRules` + `DiscoveryContext`), `discovery_cache.dart` (`DiscoveryCache` TTL + `DiscoveryPersister` NoOp/InMemory), `discovery_engine.dart` (`DiscoveryEngine`: ServiceRoot → 5 seeds → concurrent cycle-safe BFS depth ≤3, ETag-aware 304 replay, graceful per-branch 404, `invalidate`, `rawTree`).
- Fixtures `test/fixtures/redfish/*.json` (OpenBMC bmcweb-style + DMTF minimal) + `FakeBmc` Dio-interceptor harness; `discovery_engine_test.dart` (30 cases) + `feature_rules_test` + `odata_test`.

**Decisions:**
- Engine consumes `RedfishClient.dio` directly (TLS-first headers/timeout inherited) and converts 4xx/5xx + 304 via `RedfishException.fromDioException`; ServiceRoot failure surfaces as `RedfishException`, branch failures are tolerated.
- `SensorCollection` routed into the sensor count (its `Members` length) since real OpenBMC exposes sensors as a collection.
- Persister is an interface with NoOp default + InMemory test stand-in; `hive`/`shared_preferences` deferred to #010 (no native dep added).

**Next:**
- #003 unblocks #004 (multi-system manager) and #005–#010. Next worker: wire `DiscoveryEngine`/`SystemFeatures` into `DiscoveryPage` UI + a per-system provider (#004), then power (#005).

**Issues touched:**
- #003 — COMPLETE (analyze 0, 93 tests green, 91.0% discovery coverage) → closing.

## 2026-08-27 — agent:opencode — #005 (close)

**Done:**
- Completed issue #005 (Power management). `PowerService.reset(systemId, ResetType)` POSTs `/redfish/v1/Systems/{id}/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset` with the Redfish `ResetType` body, resolving the target via discovery raw tree → known `@odata.id` → live `/redfish/v1/Systems` crawl → canonical fallback. Unsupported types rejected locally (`SystemFeatures.supportedResetTypes`); 202+`Location` accepted (task polling deferred to #008). `PowerState`/`ResetType` enums, `PowerController` (optimistic transition + non-blocking 3s/30s polling), and Riverpod `powerServiceProvider`/`powerControllerProvider` families. `PowerView` gated on `features.powerControl` (renders nothing otherwise), animated `PowerBadge` (pulse only while transitioning), destructive-styled `ResetButton`s (disabled when unsupported), and `ConfirmResetDialog`. Error taxonomy: 403 → insufficient privilege, 409 → system busy, 400 → `@Message.ExtendedInfo`.
- Tests: 37 (service + controller + view + providers + model), all green; `flutter analyze` → **0 issues**; `features/power/` line coverage **87.4%** (gate ≥80%). Full suite now **182 passed / 1 skipped**.

**Decisions:**
- `RedfishError.fromJson` now extracts `Message` from `@Message.ExtendedInfo` entries (previously stored the whole map via `toString()`), so 400 extended-info messages surface correctly. `PowerBadge` only starts its pulse animation for transitional states (idle badges stay static, so `pumpAndSettle` in widget tests converges).
- Removed garbled/duplicate scratch scaffolding from the prior interrupted #005 session (`test/features/power/power_models_test.dart`, `test/scratch_debug_test.dart`) and fixed several test-harness bugs (wrong `overrideWith` arity, `expectLater(...) as RedfishException` cast, missing `id:'bmc1'` in `ConnectionProfile`, `find.widgetWithText` for disabled buttons, malformed 403 mock replying 202).

**Next:**
- #006 System overview adaptive cards (next open by priority). Power tab already routed via `app_router.dart` + gated in `SystemShell`.

**Issues touched:**
- #005 — COMPLETE (analyze 0, 37 power tests green, 87.4% power coverage; full suite 182 passed) → closing.

     parse the served `#Task.v1_7_3.Task` shape: TaskState (13 values per
     `Task.v1_7_4.json`), TaskStatus, optional `PercentComplete`, RFC3339
     Start/EndTime, `Messages[]`, `TaskMonitor`. Terminal classification:
     Completed/OK (or absent status) = success; Killed/Exception/Service/
     Cancelled + Completed-with-Warning/Critical = failure with a reason from
     `Message.Message` → `MessageId` → bare TaskState. The fixture's 545 never
     publishes PercentComplete — the parse tolerates it (unknown).

     the 202 `Retry-After` hint for the first wait, then polling at `interval`
     up to `maxPolls`; terminal success returns the task, terminal failure
     throws a normalized `RedfishException`, budget exhaustion throws a
     retryable `TaskMonitorTimeout`, a missing monitor throws
     `Base.1.0.NoTaskMonitor` (the 204-no-Location fixture norm).
  3. **`FirmwareController.pollLastTask`** — raises `polling`, stores the final
     `RedfishTask` in `lastResult` (or the error); no-monitor is a documented
     no-op.

## 2026-10-26 — agent:redfish-automation — #008/#020 binary/multipart push upload transport (EMULATOR)

**Done:**
- EMULATOR primary per alternation (last primary: DOCS 01:18). Landed the
  #008/#020 **push upload transport**: `PushImageRequest` (bytes, filename,
  contentType, optional applyTime + targets; `toUpdateParametersJson()` emits
  the Redfish `UpdateParameters` body only when set) and
  `FirmwareService.pushImage`:
  - Single-push: POST the raw `Uint8List` body to `HttpPushUri` — dio
    computes Content-Length so `onSendProgress` fires (the bare-Stream
    without Content-Length never fires; the 22:05 journal trap).
  - Multipart: `FormData` with an `UpdateFile` part + optional
    `UpdateParameters` JSON when `MultipartHttpPushUri` is advertised.
  - Chosen push URI resolved against the UpdateService resource URI per
    DSP0266's relative-reference rule (mockup `/FWUpdate` →
    `/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FWUpdate`).
  - Non-2xx normalizes to friendly `RedfishException`s (the mockup's 400 on
    the unimplemented `/FWUpdate` seam surfaces as HTTP 400, no masking);
    `NoPushUri` / `NotConnected` dedicated errors; a 202 + `Location` returns
    an `UpdateTask` for the existing `pollTask`.
- `FirmwareController.pushImage` (uploading + uploadProgress `({sent,
  total})?`) + the firmware-view upload banner (merged semantics label +
  byte-count LinearProgressIndicator) drive the flow.
- REQUIREMENTS.md: "Last audited" header rewritten; the bmcweb firmware-update
  trace row flips **Partial → OK** (transport); the two historical pins that
  described the push flow as unit-only updated with the new live pin + the
  implemented pick-single-push behavior.
- Full unit suite 480 → **496 passed / 1 skipped** (+16); analyze 0; emulator
  84 → **85/85 green** (+1 live pin: `pushImage` picks the single-push URI and
  normalizes the mockup's 400 seam end-to-end).

**Decisions:**
- EMULATOR per alternation; the FUTUREWORK focus pointed at the #008/#020
  opening items — the transport was the code-first piece (the file-picker /
  apply-time / timeline UI needs the transport underneath to test against).
- `Uint8List` body instead of a raw Stream for the single-push path because
  dio can only compute Content-Length (and therefore fire onSendProgress)
  for length-known bodies; the multipart path uses `FormData` which dio also
  measures. Progress-bytes UX stays honest even when the fixture never
  completes an upload (its 400 seam is normalized before any banner noise).
- Kept the mockup's 400 normalization un-masked: no fabricated error code,
  the served text (or "HTTP 400") surfaces — the OLD #020 masking defect is
  the exact opposite behaviour and stays pinned by the 400-no-masking test.
- Chose the 85/85 emulator pin over expanding the harness: one service-level
  pin proves the pick-single-push + normalize seam end-to-end against the
  real fixture without depending on the fixture gaining multipart support.

Warm a cold cache from the persister unconditionally (then crawl with the conditional ETag) rather than returning a persisted fresh entry directly: the persister is a slower mirror and the crawl still verifies freshness via 304, matching the documented "load seeds ETags before a crawl" contract. Kept `forceRefresh` semantics unchanged (bypass cache + persister, unconditional crawl) and pinned it with a test — the old doc comment wrongly claimed forceRefresh reused ETags; corrected rather than changing behavior.
